items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch or monetization expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: SearchWoot source rights do not authorize public/commercial display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising; all four launch-readiness tasks remain open; security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not send rights outreach or expose the product. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow and retention, log/vendor/incident procedures, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is missing for field-level source rights, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback. Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results, GA4 analytics, and operational logs/Cloudflare data are evidence_needed. Smallest next action: produce and attach the consolidated read-only evidence bundle, then route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel before any owner-authorized outreach.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. The checklist lacks dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach the dated readiness packet for each property.

Fleet compliance and data-quality review: the compliance scan is a technical baseline only, with 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; revenue contains $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21 that is not site-attributable; operations deploy, uptime, error, and fleet-doctor results are unavailable. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as zero or as proof of noncompliance. Ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally, but public exposure, security-sensitive releases, unsupported claims, monetization expansion, and new data collection remain gated.
